mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a quarter indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to concerns about economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same period, it signals a strong demand environment, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% MoM
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong job growth, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% month-over-month for three consecutive months signals inflationary pressure, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates monetary tightening.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% MoM for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 2%, it signals a strong demand environment with accommodative monetary policy, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: economic expansion with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.
